rule: Compare paired episode distributions, seed sensitivity and event timing; prefer lower measured latency among configurations with no meaningful worsening across control metrics. 10% relative MAE bands are descriptive screening bands, not robot acceptance limits.
cautions: Velocity and acceleration are errors versus recorded targets, not physical stability proof
Gripper range/force-change selected windows are not annotated successful grasps or contacts
One 30Hz frame is 33.33ms; event timing must be reported separately from average gripper MAE
